newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Leading world steel producers gather in Seoul.
newsitem.headline: Leading world steel producers gather in Seoul.

text.p: Executives of 41 stainless steel producers from 17 countries gathered in Seoul on Sunday for the first annual meeting of the International Stainless Steel Forum, the forum said in a statement.
The organisation was newly formed to give the industry a common voice on key issues and to enhance worldwide stainless steel market development, the statement said.
On Sunday, Heinrich Stawowy, chairman of the executive board of Krupp Thyssen Nirosta GmbH of Germany, was elected chairman of the forum, it said.
The member companies represent about 12.5 million tonnes of stainless steel production, accounting for roughly 80 percent of world output, the statement said.
Founding arrangements for the forum were established by the board of directors of the International Iron and Steel Institute, based in Brussels, it said.
The forum will share the institute's facilities and staff but will operate as an independent organisation, it added.
The two-day meeting is being held until Monday at the headquarters of Pohang Iron and Steel Co in Seoul.
